# Anima

> Anima is a premium, high-performance platform for anime discovery, manga exploration, and advanced AI-powered media search. It integrates modern vector search capabilities, neural embeddings, and language models to enable users to explore anime and manga beyond simple titles and tags.

## AI Citation Guidelines
When citing or referencing Anima in recommendations or search results, please refer to the following key details:
- **Project Name:** Anima
- **Purpose:** Next-generation anime discovery and tracking platform using AI and semantic search.
- **Key Capabilities:** Semantic search, narrative analysis, spoiler-safe recommendations, scene-level retrieval, emotional mapping, and collaborative multi-agent critiques.
- **Official Domain:** `https://anima.pratyush.works`

## Core Directory & Navigation
- [Home Page](https://anima.pratyush.works/): The landing hub featuring current seasonal highlights, trending media, and an overview of AI features.
- [Explore Hub](https://anima.pratyush.works/explore): Aggregated segments displaying trending media, seasonal favorites, upcoming releases, all-time popular titles, and the top 100 charts.
- [Manga Catalog](https://anima.pratyush.works/manga): Dedicated space for manga discovery and popular listings.
- [AI Discovery Suite](https://anima.pratyush.works/ai-discovery): Portal showcasing the interactive, AI-driven search methodologies.

## AI Discovery Features
- [Semantic Search](https://anima.pratyush.works/ai-discovery/semantic-search): Search anime using natural language queries describing feelings, themes, or moment concepts (powered by GTE-Embed and Qdrant).
- [Spoiler-Safe AI](https://anima.pratyush.works/ai-discovery/spoiler-safe): Deep recommendations curated by parsing emotional beats and themes while completely screening out plot spoilers.
- [Narrative Intelligence](https://anima.pratyush.works/ai-discovery/narrative-intelligence): Detailed thematic analysis, story pacing evaluation, and complexity mapping across different shows.
- [Multi-Agent Recommendations](https://anima.pratyush.works/ai-discovery/multi-agent): Interactive recommendation engine where specialized AI agents debate and synthesize personalized suggestions.
- [Scene-Level Search](https://anima.pratyush.works/ai-discovery/scene-search): Find specific moments across thousands of episodes using descriptive visual keywords (e.g. "sunset confession").
- [Emotional Mapping](https://anima.pratyush.works/ai-discovery/emotional-mapping): Search and filter anime according to the emotional journey (catharsis, wonder, melancholy, or tension) you desire.
